title: Intersection of Two Arrays
description:
Given two integer arrays `nums1` and `nums2`, return an array of their **intersection**.

Each element in the result must be **unique** and you may return the result in any order.

In database query engines and feature engineering, computing the distinct set intersection of identifiers across user activity logs is a core primitive.

### 💡 Intuition & Approach
The implementation solves **Intersection of Two Arrays** directly following its mathematical and algorithmic specification.

### ⚡ Python Reference Implementation
```python
def ds_py_intersection_arrays(nums1: list, nums2: list) -> list:
    return sorted(list(set(nums1) & set(nums2)))
```
